reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new private-node zonelist to improve memory allocation efficiency on NUMA nodes. It adds a local-only zonelist type for private nodes, which restricts allocations to a single node and reduces complexity.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new private-node zonelist to the Linux kernel's memory management system, allowing for more efficient allocation of memory on NUMA nodes. The private-node zonelist is designed to restrict allocations to a single node, reducing complexity and improving performance.
